theorem lemma8_tiny {R : ℝ} (hR2 : 2 ≤ R) (hR : R < 6) : Real.log R + 0.25068 < WR R := by
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ ⌊R⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hR2)
  have hn5 : ⌊R⌋₊ ≤ 5 := by
    have h := (Nat.floor_lt hR0.le).2 (show R < ((6 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num; linarith)
    omega
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := lemma8_tiny_num ⌊R⌋₊ hn2 hn5
  exact lemma8_of_num hR2 hA hB

proof_context.conclusion: Proves the inequality for 2<=R<6 from exact finite sums at floor(R).

/-- **[MV73, Lemma 8]** (with kernel checks for `R < 1000`): for `R ≥ 2`,
`∑_{r ≤ R} (1 + r/R)⁻¹ μ(r)²/φ(r) > log R + 0.25068`. -/
theorem lemma8 {R : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) : Real.log R + 0.25068 ≤ WR R := by
  rcases lt_or_ge R 6 with h | h
  · exact (lemma8_tiny hR h).le
  rcases lt_or_ge R 1000 with h' | h'
  · exact (TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.SmallW.lemma8_mid h h').le
  · exact lemma8_large lemma7 h'

proof_context.conclusion: Combines the three ranges: log R + 0.25068 <= W(R) for R>=2.
